        # Step 1: Navigate to entry view: http://127.0.0.1:8112/

        assert '/about' in page.url, f'Expected /about in URL, got {page.url}'
        assert '📋 TaskDash' in page.locator('body').inner_text(), f'Expected heading/landmark 📋 TaskDash'
        assert page.locator('a.tab[href="/"]').count() > 0
